what: Graphitic N on the 204-atom coil: TB (xu_chn, kz=4) site screening of 51 classes, 5 best + one 6-6-7 and one 6-6-6 relaxed; GPAW PBE LCAO dzp kz=2 single points at the TB geometries (spin-paired)
tb_screening: unrelaxed spread 1.93 eV; relaxed: the three 5-5-6 classes (atoms shared by two pentagons) within 0.07 eV, every other category 0.67-0.87 eV above; topology intact, C-N 1.39-1.46 A
conclusion: GPAW confirms the main TB result: N prefers the atom shared by two pentagons, by 0.40-0.59 eV (TB 0.67-0.87: TB overstates it by 0.2-0.5 eV). Among the other categories the order differs (all within 0.19 eV in GPAW): not resolved at this level. Single points at TB geometries (PBE forces up to 1.5 eV/A); differences below ~0.2 eV would need PBE relaxation.
note: each GPAW job takes 3.4-4 GB; with 15 GB RAM at most 3 run at once (a fourth was killed silently twice)
